noAccess.title: You do not have access
noAccess.body: Your roles do not include the permission this screen needs. Ask a workspace Owner or Admin to grant it.
noAccess.bodyWithKey: This screen needs the permission {permission}. Ask a workspace Owner or Admin to add it to one of your roles.

blurb.admin: Admin: full workspace access, no billing.
blurb.manager: Manager: sees all, can assign and resolve.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again; if it keeps happening, quote the request id.
errors.request: The request could not be completed.
errors.validation: Check the form and try again.
errors.passwordPolicy: This password does not meet the workspace password policy:
errors.validationField: Check this field and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this while you were editing. Reload to see their version, then re-apply your changes.
errors.grantRole: You cannot do this: that role (or the member's current role) is above your own. Only an Owner can give, change or deactivate Owners and Admins.
errors.grantPermission: You cannot grant {permission}: you do not hold it yourself.
errors.selfRoleChange: You cannot change your own role.
errors.lastOwner: The workspace must keep at least one Owner. Make someone else an Owner first.
errors.selfDeactivate: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.presetRole: Owner, Admin, Manager, Agent and Viewer are preset roles: they cannot be renamed or deleted.
errors.roleInUse: Members still hold this role. Move them to another role first, then delete it.
errors.nameTaken: A role with this name already exists.
errors.nameTooLong: The role name can have at most {max} characters.
errors.notFound: This item no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.customRolesLocked: Custom roles and scoped permissions aren't on your plan. You can read the roles but not create or change them.

team.description: Add people to this workspace, choose what each of them can do, and switch access off when someone leaves.
team.selfRoleHint: You cannot change your own role.
team.roleLockedHint: You cannot change this member's role: it is above yours, or you may not assign roles.
team.selfDeactivateHint: You cannot deactivate your own account.
team.rolesUnavailable: Roles could not be loaded for you, so adding members and changing roles is unavailable. Role chips are built from the members shown.

deactivate.title: Deactivate member
deactivate.message: {name} will no longer be able to sign in. You can reactivate them at any time.

add.title: Add member
add.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it with the person; they can change it after signing in.
add.passwordGenerated: Generated password: show it with the eye button and copy it before saving.
add.passwordShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
add.inviteHint: We email them a link to set their own password. The link works once and expires after a few days.
add.linkNotSent: The email to {email} could not be sent. Copy this link and hand it over; it will not be shown again.

changeRole.title: Change roles of {name}
changeRole.keptRole: {name} stays: you cannot hand it out or take it away.

list.description: Roles decide what members can do. Pick a preset or build a custom role from the permission matrix.
list.customRolesLocked: Custom roles and scoped permissions aren't on your plan. You can read the roles but not create or change them.

editor.description: Name the role and pick what it can do.
editor.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No members hold this role.} one {1 member holds this role.} other {# members hold this role.}}
editor.notFoundBody: This role no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
editor.discard: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
editor.lockedNotice: The Owner role holds every permission and cannot be changed or deleted
editor.adminNotice: Only an Owner can change the permissions of the Admin role.
editor.readOnlyNotice: You cannot change this role's permissions.
editor.name: Role name

matrix.title: Permissions
matrix.denyHint: Deny beats allow: a denied permission is refused even when another of the member's roles allows it.
matrix.lockedHint: This permission is not available to this workspace yet. It unlocks when the plan feature is on or the app is installed.
